entities.summary: Geoffrey Luc Fabien Malfleury is a Martiniquais professional footballer who plays as a forward. During his career, he also played in France, Switzerland, Portugal and Cyprus for teams such as Stade Nyonnais, Le Havre, Tours, União da Madeira, Alki Oroklini and FC Voluntari, among others.
